Preset.Label: Animal hauling preset
Preset.Description: Choose which hauling-related jobs trained animals may perform before they fall back to vanilla haul-to-storage behavior.

RequireHaulCapability.Label: All jobs requiring hauling capability
RequireHaulCapability.Description: Use the curated hauling-capability list. This keeps hauling-style work enabled while excluding hauling work types that are really bill or stripping jobs.

HaulingWorkType.Label: All jobs under hauling work type
HaulingWorkType.Description: Enable every work giver in RimWorld's hauling work type, including edge cases such as hauling-category bill work.

Custom.Label: Custom
Custom.Description: Enable or disable each curated hauling-capability job individually.

CustomList.Label: Job switches
CustomList.Description: These switches reflect the currently selected preset. Changing any switch will turn the preset into Custom.
